name: Community — MiniMax H3 (Singularity v2)
author: WarmBloodAban (AIGC-Singularity)
description: WarmBloodAban's Singularity v2 (released 2026-10-23), the second version of the HDR merge-and-finetune of MiniMax H3 ref2va, as the pruned int8 build: the same 21 GB size, graphs and 20-step recipe as the v1.3 checkpoint in the Singularity pack, and one checkpoint for text, image and reference to video. The v1.3 pack is unchanged, so both looks stay available: v1.3 is the calmer one, v2 the one that moves. MEASURED 2026-10-25 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti (SimpliGen engine 0.42.0, 864x480, 5 s, 20 steps, text to video, three prompts x three seeds, the same seeds on v2 and v1.3): v2 fixes v1.3's weak spot, motion. Optical flow per frame rose 38% on a tracking cyclist shot (7.7 vs 5.6, level with H3 Midnight) and 22% in a sword duel (3.0 vs 2.5, more than Midnight), on every seed, and v2 was the only model whose duellists actually crossed blades. The trade: it is darker still. A dim-studio portrait came back at half v1.3's brightness (mean luma 17 vs 35) and a sunlit courtyard at two thirds (56 vs 82), on every seed, and v2 frames tighter on every prompt. Close-up faces stay as crisp as v1.3's. Same speed as v1.3: about 200 s per five-second 480p shot at 20 steps on the bare graph, about 2 minutes in the app with faster attention and Spectrum on (all three cards checked in the app 2026-10-25). The author recommends naming the style in the prompt (photorealistic, East Asian realism, 3D CG, cinematic CG) and keeping prompts under about 5,000 characters. LICENCE: the model card says Apache-2.0, but this is a derivative of MiniMax H3 weights, which places it under the MiniMax H3 Community License like every other H3 checkpoint - check that licence before shipping anything made with it. Encoder and VAEs are the official Comfy-Org files shared with the other H3 packs, so the only new download is the 21 GB checkpoint. From 1.1.0 the pack also has a Reference to Video card with prithivMLmods' Facial Realism close-up LoRA built in: brighter, more matte skin and more motion on a walk than the plain v2 card, at the same speed.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Text to Video (Singularity v2)
presets.description:
Text to video with more motion than Singularity v1.3. Moving shots such as a tracking cyclist or a sword duel come out livelier.

The trade is a darker picture: a sunlit scene came back about a third darker than v1.3, and a dim one about half. It also frames tighter. Close-up faces stay as crisp as v1.3's.

Use this card when the shot has to move, and v1.3 for a calmer look.

A five-second 480p shot takes about 2 minutes on a 12 GB card.

Licence: the model card says Apache-2.0, but this is built on MiniMax H3 weights, so the MiniMax H3 Community License applies. Check it before shipping anything made with this.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.
presets.tagline: Describe a scene - Singularity's look with more motion, darker

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Reference to Video (Singularity v2)
presets.description:
Reference to video with more motion than Singularity v1.3, with up to nine references. In the app, one picture of a woman held her face through a walking shot on three seeds, each hitting the prompted glance and smile. A two-person shot from two separate pictures held both people and spoke its one line word for word, with no extra words after it.

A five-second 480p shot takes about 2 minutes on a 12 GB card.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Reference to Video (Singularity v2 Facial Realism)
presets.description:
Reference to video on Singularity v2 with prithivMLmods' Facial Realism close-up LoRA built in. Against the plain Singularity v2 card on the same seeds and reference, faces came out with more matte skin and without the shiny cheek highlight, the picture was brighter, and a walking shot moved more. It also stages the shot differently, so a seed will not give you the same picture as on the plain card.

The card puts "Facial Realism:" in front of your prompt by itself. Do not type the trigger.

The LoRA was trained on close-up face portraits and was tested here on close and medium shots of one person. Use the plain Singularity v2 card when you want its darker look.

A five-second 480p shot takes about 2 minutes on a 12 GB card, the same as the plain card.

Licence: the LoRA and the checkpoint are both built on MiniMax H3 weights, so the MiniMax H3 Community License applies. Check it before shipping anything made with this.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.
presets.tagline: Up to nine references - Singularity v2, brighter and more matte skin

extensions.name: ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3
extensions.description: Spectrum forecaster: skips transformer evaluations it can predict. Pinned to v0.2.30 (7df883b): handles the H3 final layer before and after engine 0.45 renamed its shifts argument to grids; v0.2.27 fails on 0.45.

requirements.notes: Same checkpoint, encoder, VAEs and 20-step res_multistep/simple recipe as the plain Singularity v2 R2V card, plus prithivMLmods/MiniMax-H3-Facial-Realism-CloseUp checkpoint 2000 (rank 16, 74.6 MB, MiniMax H3 Community License) as LoraLoaderModelOnly at 1.0 before the user LoRA slot, and the trigger "Facial Realism: " in front of the prompt. BAKED 2026-11-03 on vanilla ComfyUI 0.43.0, 864x480, 5 s, one reference picture, two prompts (desk vlog, walking selfie) x three seeds against the plain card: brighter on 6 of 6 (mean luma 48.6 vs 45.2 talking, 83.5 vs 71.8 walking), more motion on all three walks (optical flow 3.16 vs 2.54 px per frame), face-crop sharpness about level (Laplacian 158 vs 161 talking, 199 vs 218 walking), and every line spoken word for word. The LoRA re-stages the shot (frame-0 difference 28-43 against the plain card, 0.0 for a same-seed rerun). Same speed on the bare graph (190-210 s). CHECKED IN THE APP 2026-11-03 (engine 0.43.0, Sage + Spectrum on, 864x480, 5 s, seed 4242, same reference) against the store's plain v2 R2V card: 123-132 s vs 119-122 s, brighter (luma 60.2 vs 49.2 talking, 85.8 vs 77.6 walking), more walking motion (flow 2.36 vs 1.64), both lines word for word on both cards, the trigger never spoken. 768p 5 s took 364-367 s. AiSeek's full recipe (lightx2v ref2v turbo 4-step v0.1 + this LoRA, euler/beta, 10 steps) was 1.7x faster but softer on every face, so it is not used here.
